summary: Iteration 11: Full E2E testing of Bill Intelligence feature (backend /api/insights/analyze + dashboard preview + /dashboard/insights page). Backend: 5/5 pytest cases PASS. Frontend: all 9 review scenarios verified via Playwright. Customer account returns correct analytics (total_spend=$2109.45, bill_count=17, categories=4, trend=stable) and rich AI insights (summary, highlights, savings_tips, seasonal_note). Admin account correctly returns analytics=null + message. Sidebar nav order matches spec (Overview, Bills, Bill Intelligence, Payment Plan, Payment Methods, Settings). Refresh works.

issues: Monthly Spending Trend card does not render for the seeded customer because all 17 seeded bills fall in a single month (2026-04) and the component gates rendering on analytics.monthly_trend.length > 1. This is correct defensive UI behaviour but the seed data prevents visual coverage of the chart. Consider seeding bills across 3+ months to showcase the trend visualisation.

action_items: (Optional) Seed additional historical bills across multiple months so the Monthly Spending Trend chart renders for the demo customer.
(Optional) dashboard insights preview card can take ~8-12s to populate on first load as it waits on GPT-4o; consider a cheaper/cached skeleton for faster first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: BillIntelligence.jsx correctly gates monthly-trend rendering on length > 1 — but a single-month dataset hides the chart; consider showing a single-month fallback (e.g., 'Only 1 month of data available').
DashboardHome.jsx renders the insights-preview Card always, but the AI body takes ~8-12s on first load (GPT-4o). Loading skeleton inside the card is present, good.
Backend /api/insights/analyze correctly falls back to ai_insights=None on LLM failure and front-end handles this with the 'no-ai-notice' card — resilient design.
axiosInstance is used for insights fetch — auth token attached via interceptor; good pattern.
The insights endpoint does not appear to be cached; every refresh triggers a full GPT-4o call which is slow and costly. Consider server-side caching keyed on (user_id, bills_hash) with short TTL.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded 17 bills for customer; admin has no bills which is correct for empty-state test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bill Intelligence feature is production-ready. Backend endpoint /api/insights/analyze verified with live GPT-4o (~6-8s response). Dashboard home preview card (insights-preview) requires ~10-12s wait after login for AI content to populate — tests must wait long enough. /dashboard/insights page loads within 20-30s max. Sidebar shows 'Bill Intelligence' between 'Bills' and 'Payment Plan' as required. All data-testids from the spec are present and rendered EXCEPT monthly-trend which is correctly hidden when seed data has only a single month — this is not a bug.
